comments.text:
In the mean time, I've spent time playing around reducing the example to a smaller one with "easier" data:

```
mkD <- function(nlog2.w = 111) {
    stopifnot(length(nlog2.w) == 1, nlog2.w >= 13)
    data.frame(
        y = c(29, 24, -10, 35, 8, 13, -23, 2, 18, -48, -22, -32, -68, 19, 42, 32, -9, -73, -13, 0, 12),
        x = c(71, 35, -8, 64, 22, -8, -56, -7, 24, -83, -48, -35, -125, 65, 81, 76, -40, -148, -25, 13, 16),
        wts = c(0, 2^-c(rep(nlog2.w, 2), 13:8), rep(1, 12))) # wts is increasing [0 ... 1]
}

df <- mkD()
```
but one can play around, using  e.g.,    `df <- mkD(100)`  instead.

Currently, I'm pretty convinced we should change things in  `lm.wfit()` :
Basically,from
```
  zero.weights <- any(w == 0)
```
to (something like, as we rely on our own double prec `qr()`)
```
  zero.weights <- any(nok <- w <= 1e-30 * max(w))
```
and then, inside the  `if(zero.weights) { .... }`  clause, replace
```
    ok <- w != 0
    nok <- !ok
```
with

```
   ok <- !nok
```

The cutoff 1e-30 is only somewhat arbitrary:  as in the code, really
`wts <- sqrt(w)`  is used, 1e-30 corresponds to  1e-15 on the `wts` scale which is about 4--5 times `.Machine$double.eps`.
As Sebastian also "shows" in comment 9, for such small weights, things are really unstable (as actually also, the OP Hamed Haseli said almost 8 years ago..).

> I can work on 16008 after checking the patch proposed here. IMO it looks
> correct but I'll look in detail.

Thank you, Mikael and Mauricio.
I have now added some regression tests, and a NEWS entry and committed
to svn rev 90471 (R-devel).

Note that I've indeed kept the default  `wtol = 0`  back compatibly.
This is to allow more people (and myself) to collect experience by setting
`wtol = 1e-30` or similar.

It *is* probably too optimistic to assume that there is such a simple global default appropropriate for all cases.
Rather I'd expect an "optimal" `wtol` to be positive, but quite dependent on the
rank of the QR decomposition, and probably also on the condition number of the 
model matrix `X`.

I'm still convinced that the default `wtol = 0` should be changed in a way to be positive almost always.

(One intermediary "solution" might be the default to depend on a user-settable option, say `options(lm.wtol = 1e-30)`   but that has drawbacks and I think should *not* be permanent but only intermediary ...
